0.long_answer: The congenital condition in question is the bicuspid aortic valve. It is the most common congenital heart defect and is known to be associated with dilatation of the aorta, the largest artery in the body. Individuals with a bicuspid aortic valve often develop an enlargement or aneurysmal change in the ascending aorta due to the altered hemodynamics and structural changes in the aortic wall.
